scope: Local v3 release operator configuration and ordinary Phoenix startup on synthetic signed data

commands.compile: MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors and MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors
commands.seed: MIX_ENV=test mix test --warnings-as-errors --trace test/mixer_hosted/releases/postgres_test.exs:192 with MIXER_RELEASE_LEDGER_TEST_PORT=5432 and MIXER_RELEASE_LEDGER_TEST_SOCKET pointing to the owned PostgreSQL socket
commands.provision: psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f priv/local_release_delivery/provision_reader.sql connected to the disposable mixer_local_release_ledger database
commands.startup: MIX_ENV=dev mix phx.server, once with both settings absent and once with the exact host, channel and public roots from signed-release-v3.json and a separate SCRAM password. The API used the OTP per-process CA path for the disposable CA.
commands.browser: MIX_ENV=test mix test --seed 0 --warnings-as-errors test/mixer_hosted/releases/browser_publication_test.exs with an isolated PostgreSQL cluster and the synthetic browser catalog fixture

readerDenied: membership in ledger_runtime or any role

limits: The ordinary startup read used seeded fixture publications and a disposable CA, with browser auth disabled. The separate authenticated browser regression uses synthetic sign-in and its test storage profile. Normal CLI publication depends on the sibling WriterRepo activation after its review fixes. This slice records no L05 or GA passage.
